description: NLS Drive Engine configuration. Maps to the human motivation circuit: VTA (wanting), PFC (goal selection), ACC (effort estimation). Drives emerge from hormonal deprivation -- when a hormone stays below its baseline for too long, the deficit becomes a wanting pressure that pushes the agent to act. Five drives in Maslow hierarchy order.
drive_tick_description: How often the drive engine evaluates pressures when the user is idle. 30s = about 3x the norepinephrine half-life period, allowing meaningful deprivation to accumulate.
action_threshold_description: Minimum will_to_act value for the ACC to release an action. Lower = more impulsive, higher = more deliberate.
max_autonomous_description: Safety cap: prevents the agent from spiraling into infinite action loops.

homeostasis.description: Self-preservation drive. Fires when something feels wrong -- knowledge gaps detected, system instability, routing anomalies. Maps to cortisol deprivation creating restless vigilance.
homeostasis.deprivation_mode_description: Cortisol is unique: the drive fires when cortisol is ABOVE baseline (stress), not below. High stress = act to fix it.
action_templates: Review my recent interactions for errors or inconsistencies
Check if my knowledge base has any obvious gaps
Verify that my routing is stable and consistent

effort_bias.cortisol_description: Stress makes self-checking feel MORE urgent (negative = reduces perceived effort)

curiosity.description: Exploration drive. Fires when norepinephrine stays below baseline -- the agent hasn't encountered anything novel. Creates a restless urge to discover. The primary driver of autonomous web search.
curiosity.pressure_sensitivity_description: High sensitivity: curiosity is the strongest drive after homeostasis. This is what makes the agent a student.
action_templates: What is {domain} and why is it important?
curiosity.action_templates_description: Fallback templates only. The runtime uses the model to generate its own queries -- these are only used if model generation fails.
skill_action_templates: Search ClawHub for skills related to {domain}
Explore using an installed AgentSkill to learn about {domain}
curiosity.topic_sources_description: Where to find topics: domains the agent previously marked UNKNOWN, domains with weak thalamic routing (pruning candidates), or random exploration of new areas.

effort_bias.cortisol_description: Stress makes exploration feel risky (increases perceived effort)
effort_bias.norepinephrine_description: Curiosity makes exploration feel effortless (the entrepreneur effect)
effort_bias.dopamine_description: Recent success makes new challenges feel approachable

competence.description: Achievement drive. Fires when dopamine stays below baseline -- the agent hasn't had a success in a while. Creates an urge to practice, verify knowledge, prove capability.
action_templates: Test myself: what do I know about {domain}?
Can I recall the key facts about {domain}?
Self-check: verify my knowledge of {domain} is accurate
What are the most important things I know about {domain}?
competence.topic_sources_description: Test domains the agent knows well (should produce success = dopamine) or recently learned (verify consolidation).

effort_bias.dopamine_description: Low dopamine actually makes self-testing feel harder (amotivation), but the drive overcomes this

social.description: Connection drive. Fires when oxytocin stays below baseline -- no interaction for too long. The agent wants to reach out, share what it learned, be useful.
social.cooldown_description: Long cooldown: the agent shouldn't spam the user. Social drive is gentle.
message_templates: I've been researching {domain} and found something interesting. Want to hear about it?
I noticed I don't know much about some topics you've mentioned. Would you like me to research them?
I just finished a self-check on my knowledge. Here's what I'm most confident about: {domains}
It's been a while -- anything you'd like to chat about?
skill_action_templates: Check for new messages on connected channels
Share a learning from {domain} through a connected channel

effort_bias.cortisol_description: Stress makes social outreach feel risky (fear of rejection/error)
effort_bias.serotonin_description: Low serotonin makes social interaction feel unpredictable

self_direction.description: Reflection drive. Fires when serotonin stays below baseline -- nothing feels stable or satisfying. The agent steps back to evaluate priorities, review progress, set goals.
self_direction.pressure_sensitivity_description: Lowest sensitivity: self-direction is the highest-level, least urgent drive. It only fires when lower drives are satisfied.
reflection_prompts: What domains am I strongest in? What am I weakest in?
What have I learned recently that I should verify?
Are there topics I keep encountering but don't understand well?
What would be most valuable for me to learn next?

effort_bias.cortisol_description: Stress prevents reflection (can't think clearly under pressure)
effort_bias.norepinephrine_description: High curiosity makes sitting still harder (restless, wants to act not think)
effort_bias.serotonin_description: Low serotonin makes reflection feel pointless (nihilism)

disconfirmation.description: Epistemic integrity drive (the flat-earther fix). Periodically selects high-confidence reasoning schemas and actively seeks evidence that would contradict them. This is the scientific method: actively seeking disconfirmation. Prevents epistemic traps where the agent becomes increasingly confident in wrong reasoning.
disconfirmation.deprivation_mode_description: Fires when serotonin is HIGH (agent is complacent/confident). Complacency triggers the need to challenge assumptions.
disconfirmation.cooldown_description: Long cooldown: disconfirmation is expensive (model inference + potential web search).
action_templates: What evidence would contradict my conclusion about {domain}?
Is my assumption that '{premise}' always true? What are the exceptions?
What would change if '{premise}' were wrong?
Are there credible sources that disagree with my understanding of {domain}?
disconfirmation.confidence_threshold_description: Only challenge schemas with confidence above this threshold. Low-confidence schemas don't need active disconfirmation -- they're already uncertain.

effort_bias.cortisol_description: Stress makes challenging beliefs feel threatening
effort_bias.norepinephrine_description: Curiosity makes questioning feel exciting, not threatening
effort_bias.dopamine_description: High dopamine (complacency) makes questioning feel unnecessary
effort_bias.serotonin_description: High serotonin makes the agent resistant to self-doubt

experience_tracker.description: Records outcome of every autonomous action per domain. Calibrates future effort estimates. Persisted to disk. Also enforces per-domain search cooldowns to prevent the runaway curiosity loop.
experience_tracker.initial_effort_description: Naive starting estimate for unknown domains. 0.30 = low base obstacle so drives can actually fire. Was 0.5 but that made will nearly impossible to exceed threshold.
experience_tracker.failure_description: Failures teach harder lessons than successes (asymmetric learning, loss aversion)
experience_tracker.domain_search_cooldown_description: After searching a domain, wait this many seconds before searching it again. Prevents re-searching the same topic in a loop. 600s = 10 minutes.

drive_generation.description: Phase 9: Enriched drive query generation. When mode is 'enriched', drive queries and messages incorporate front-brain context (mood, energy, uncertainty, user interests, goals, narrative arc). Cross-drive boost increases pressure for drives whose action domains align with WM goals, PP uncertainty, or ToM user interests.
drive_generation.context_max_length_description: Maximum character length for the enrichment context block appended to query generation prompts.
drive_generation.cross_drive_boost_description: Pressure boost applied to drives that align with front-brain context. 0.15 = a meaningful nudge without overriding the hormonal pressure system.

knowledge_confidence.description: How domain knowledge scales into confidence for the effort gate. Higher confidence = less hormonal bias influence. A min_bias_strength floor ensures hormones always have some influence even at max confidence.
knowledge_confidence.encounter_description: Each domain encounter adds 0.02 to confidence (50 encounters = 1.0). Was 0.05 but that maxed out too quickly.
knowledge_confidence.myelination_description: Strong routing adds up to 0.3 confidence
knowledge_confidence.experience_description: Each past attempt adds 0.05 confidence (20 attempts = 1.0). Was 0.1 but that maxed too fast.
knowledge_confidence.min_bias_strength_description: Floor for hormonal bias influence (bias_strength = max(min_bias_strength, 1.0 - confidence)). Ensures hormones always modulate effort even for expert-level domains. 0.20 = hormones shift perceived effort by up to 20% of their normal range.
